title: Comsol Networks selects managed optical fiber network solution from Adtran and NEC XON to drive 5G growth in South Africa
summary: Adtran today announced that Comsol Networks has selected a managed optical fiber network (MOFN) solution from Adtran and NEC XON to support the next phase of its 5G expansion.
body_markdown:
News summary:


- Fixed wireless access provider Comsol Networks is expanding DCI capacity to support the rollout of its 5G network
- MOFN solution based on Adtran FSP 3000 technology simplifies optical operations while providing a scalable foundation for growth
- Deployment accelerates service delivery and provides a clear path from 100G to 400G and 800G capacity


Adtran today announced that Comsol Networks has selected a managed optical fiber network (MOFN) solution from Adtran and NEC XON to support the next phase of its 5G expansion. Comsol Networks, a leading South African provider of fixed wireless access and private networks, is expanding its business-focused 5G network to meet rising demand for high-performance connectivity. To support that growth, the company is strengthening its data center interconnect (DCI) infrastructure with a managed solution that removes the complexity of operating a dedicated optical transport environment, enabling its teams to focus on expanding services and growing the business.
